scope: Actual harmonic-basis coarse differential coefficients at all seventeen CM points; independent kernels, involution-refined errors and the anchor precision gate.

sources.title: Cameron Franc and Marc Masdeu, Computing fundamental domains for the Bruhat-Tits tree for GL2(Qp), p-adic automorphic forms, and the canonical embedding of Shimura curves
sources.use: Poisson evaluation and integration of locally analytic kernels from moments as the computational framework. The actual ramified-field convergence and error bounds used here are proved in D108/D113 and refined directly in D114; no Qp precision proposition or control theorem is transferred unchanged.

local_sources.use: The rational residue frame and Gaussian/ratio-jet requirements, which remain separate from the present harmonic-basis evaluation.
Ramified three-chart Poisson expansions, the exact coarse-coordinate formula, tail bounds and transformation law.
The frozen coarse formula and the exact defining CM polynomial; its old synthetic data are not substituted for actual moments.
The sixteen actual G-invariant bounded measures with denominator bound d=0.
Exact CM coordinates and embedded involutions acting as z -> beta^2/z.
All existing contracting child maps and CM ball maps, with coefficient-error bounds at least 159 and 165.
Frozen bit-plane ring arithmetic used only within its proved precision-at-most-16 range.
The finite contraction proof, previous moment bank and 696 inherited source hashes.

project_deductions: At precision P, child-map coefficients in moment columns k>=P vanish uniformly in the row degree. Solve only degrees 0 through P-1, then recover higher rows without a larger fixed system.
Precision 16 with state cutoff 46 and CM cutoff 31 gives 130848 state entries and 26112 CM entries; all earlier D113 state values agree after reduction.
Combining the D108 Taylor-to-coarse formula with chart moments gives integral kernel coefficients and avoids approximate division by beta.
Retaining exact binomial valuations improves the original three-chart errors to 24,32,24 pi-digits for coarse orders 0,1,2.

Independent expansion of K_j(t)=(1-((beta+t)/(beta-t))^(2j+2))/2 verifies all 288 coefficients. Temporary beta^96 precision pays explicitly for the division by 2 and retains beta^80 arithmetic accuracy.
The actual CM involution exchanges chart A with its complement and preserves K_j and the measure. Hence g_j=2 integral_A K_j dmu, giving stronger errors 32,40,32 pi-digits.
All 256 non-anchor entries at each of the three coarse orders are certified nonzero. The values remain in the harmonic basis and specified local coarse coordinate.
At W, moments 0 through 31 on A vanish modulo pi^16. Monic division by (X^2-X)^16 proves every polynomial moment is divisible by pi^16, so raising only the degree cutoff cannot resolve this anchor.
The anchor coarse coefficients have lower valuation bounds 32.5,40.5,32.5 in v_pi; these are not exact vanishing or nonvanishing certificates.

software.name: Python standard library
software.use: Exact integer/rational arithmetic, binomial kernels, source hashes and bounded process groups.

software.name: NumPy
software.use: Bounded integer convolutions and matrix products; no floating-point solves or tolerance-based certificates.

excluded_inferences: These are actual coarse differential 2-jets in the harmonic basis, not rational-frame ratio jets or a candidate identification.
No harmonic-to-residue basis change, normalization, Gaussian pivot or target field polynomial.
No exact vanishing or certified nonzero coarse value at W.
The bit-plane shortcut is not valid at precision 24 without the additional Eisenstein terms; the next run needs new quotient arithmetic.
No new class census, level, Hecke bank, cubic-precision run or final-scale performance claim.
No unchanged Qp control theorem, Qp precision proposition or inert-31 equality threshold is used over the ramified field.
